scope.summary: There were no candidates to audit. Every change only sets a pointer to NULL after it is freed, and no API, return value or ownership contract changes. The supplied ossfuzz.sh shows the build: libcjson.a is built statically with CMake, and the harness is compiled with $CXX against it. The headers are unchanged and no new warning-prone construct appears, so the build passes. All six change groups and all four foundations are resolved.

assessments.reason: cJSON_Delete only adds NULL assignments after deallocate, and its deletion semantics are unchanged. The harness calls cJSON_Delete on every successful parse.

The parse_string failure path sets local output to NULL after freeing it and still returns false. The harness reaches it through cJSON_ParseWithOpts with malformed strings and handles the NULL result.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: parse_value dispatches to parse_string on a quote character

assessments.reason: On the reallocate success path, print() sets buffer->buffer to NULL and still returns printed. The harness frees that result.
The print() failure and copy paths set pointers to NULL after free and still return NULL or printed. The harness checks for NULL before calling free.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Unbuffered print calls and NULL-checked free

assessments.reason: When printing fails, cJSON_PrintBuffered sets p.buffer to NULL after freeing it and still returns NULL. The harness calls it with prebuffer 1 when the buffered flag is set.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Frees the result only when it is non-NULL

assessments.reason: The cJSON_free change only assigns NULL to its by-value parameter, which has no effect outside the function. The complete harness never calls cJSON_free and uses free().

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Complete harness, with no cJSON_free call

build.reason: ossfuzz.sh builds static libcjson.a with CMake, then compiles cjson_read_fuzzer.c with $CXX and links it. The harness includes ../cJSON.h inside extern "C", and the declarations it uses are unchanged. The changes add only plain NULL stores to pointers that are already read, which is not a -Werror hazard.

input.reason: The harness requires 4 flag bytes and a trailing NUL. This keeps strlen in cJSON_ParseWithOpts bounded, and the parse API is unchanged.

evidence.dependency_reason: Uses strlen on the NUL-terminated input

lifecycle.reason: Printed output is freed once, the minify copy is freed once, and the tree is deleted once. The changes only set internal or local pointers to NULL after free.

control_flow.reason: The flag bytes select parse, buffered/formatted/unformatted printing and minify. The signatures of all public calls match the harness usage.
